name: ∞ Іnfіnіtе Gаmеѕ ∞
description:
2b2tPE.org (also 2b2tBE.org) is the unofficial pocket (or bedrock) edition of the java 2b2t.org for mobile and windows 10 users which has NO Rules, NO staff and encourages complete anarchy. Here you are free to do whatever you want, from Building - Griefing - Hacking and PVP.

Some 2b2t.org players play on the pocket version while waiting in the java version queue.

2b2tPE.org is the largest and most popular MCPE anarchy server in the world.

- Largest and oldest map at over 4 Terabytes!

- The most discord members, over 12,000.

Being the oldest and biggest anarchy map gives you the best chance at finding endless bases and loot well out into the millions.

Join the discord server here: https://invite.gg/2b2tpe
